decision_rule.metric: exact-set success rate per material count N
decision_rule.best_single: the higher of react and oneshot success rates; ties go to lower cost
team_worth_it_if: team success >= best single AND (team p50 latency <= 0.8x OR cost per run <= 0.8x)
decision_rule.scope: exploratory: 4 tasks x 2 samples per arm and N; no multiplicity correction
decision_rule.infrastructure: an attempt that saw HTTP 429/5xx or a request without a response is rerun from fresh state, at most 3 attempts per run; only the last attempt is graded; every attempt is kept
decision_rule.secondary: per-call provider latency, and calls slower than 30 s, are reported descriptively; they are not part of the decision
